settings.title: Pay Later in 4 Installments With No Interest

settings.text: Patrick Adair Designs offers its customers the ability to finance any purchase with no minimum purchase amount through Klarna's "Pay Later in 4 Installments" plan and Shop Pay Installments.

settings.title: How Klarna Works
settings.text:
• Use your own valid debit or credit card to pay (no prepaid cards).
  • The first payment is charged when your order is placed.
  • The next 3 payments are automatically charged every 2 weeks after your first payment.
  • There are no interest charges with Pay later in 4 installments, and no fees when you follow your automatic payment schedule.
  • A Late Fee of up to $7 may be charged if an automatic payment cannot be collected.
  • The issuer of your card may charge interest or fees under your agreement with them. If you have any questions about those charges contact your card issuer.

All products on our website qualify for Klarna's "Pay Later in 4 Installments" plan. If you have any further questions, see the complete terms here.

Disclosure: *CA resident loans made or arranged pursuant to a California Financing Law license.

settings.title: How Shop Pay Works
settings.text:
Shop Pay

1.1 Shop powers an accelerated checkout where your payment information is stored and retrieved for faster checkouts (“Shop Pay”). When you make a purchase on a Merchant store that offers Shop Pay as an accelerated checkout option (a “Shop Pay Site”), you will be asked on the checkout page if you would like to save your information. When you opt-in to save your information, you are signing up for Shop Pay, and we will collect and store certain personal information from you, such as your name, email address, and mobile phone number (“Account Information”); your credit card information and billing address (“Payment Information”); your shipping address and the shipping method you select on the checkout page of the Shop Pay Site (“Shipping Information”); and information related to your order details of goods or services purchased from a Shop Pay Site, such as the tracking number, carrier name, order number and product details (such as name, price, photos) (“Order Information”). Together, your Account Information, Payment Information, Shipping Information and Order Information are your “Saved Information”. All personal information collected from you in connection with your use of Shop is governed by the Shop Privacy Policy.

1.2 After you sign up for Shop Pay, if you use Shop Pay on a Shop Pay Site, Shopify will place a cookie on your web browser to recognize you when you return to that Shop Pay Site or any other Shop Pay Site, which will allow you to make purchases using your Saved Information. If you visit a Shop Pay Site and you are not recognized by Shop (for example, because you’ve cleared your cookies, logged out, or you’re using a device that is different from the one you used to access the Shop Pay Site during your last checkout), you will be able to access your Saved Information by inputting your email address and a verification code will be sent to you via SMS text message or a notification from Shop. After you verify your identity, Shop will allow you to make purchases using your Saved Information, including your Shipping Information provided that the Merchant offers the applicable shipping method.

1.3 You can manage your Payment Information and Shipping Information in Shop or the next time you checkout from a Shop Pay Site. Should you update your Payment Information, you consent to Shopify validating your Payment Information, including your credit card on file. If you remove a credit card from your Saved Information, this will not terminate or cancel any subscriptions you may have purchased with a Merchant using your Saved Information in Shop Pay. You must cancel your subscriptions with the Merchant directly.

1.4 Note that message and data rates may apply for any SMS messages sent to you from us and to us from you. If you have any questions about your text plan or data plan, contact your wireless provider.

Installments

1.5 When you check out with Shop Pay, you may have the option to pay in installments from participating stores. Installments are a flexible payment option that can help you invest in larger purchases up to $3,000 USD by dividing your purchase amount into four equal, biweekly, and interest-free payments.

1.6 Paying in installments with Shop Pay is powered and serviced by Affirm and is only available for payment on a limited number of Shop Pay Sites (“Eligible Shop Pay Sites”). Shopify does not determine your eligibility, and Eligible Shop Pay Sites determine the availability of the option to pay in installments with Shop Pay. While you can manage your payments in Shop, your use of installments is subject to the terms you agreed to with Affirm, including their terms of service which can be found here. Shopify is not a party to any agreement between you and Affirm, and expressly disclaims all liability with respect to such agreements.

1.7 To pay in installments with Shop Pay on an Eligible Shop Pay Site, you need to meet the following requirements:

  1. Reside in the United States.
  2. Sign up for Shop Pay.
  3. Add your debit or credit card to your Shop Pay account.
  4. Sign up for Affirm to confirm your eligibility.

1.8 The following limitations currently apply to paying in installments with Shop Pay:

  1. Existing Affirm account holders aren’t eligible for paying by installments with Shop Pay.
  2. Orders that include gift cards are excluded from paying in installments with Shop Pay.
  3. To qualify, orders need to be between $50 and $3,000 USD, inclusive of shipping and taxes.
  4. If you change your phone number within Shop Pay, then you also need to update your information with Affirm before you can pay for another purchase in installments with Shop Pay.
  5. You can’t use a Capital One credit card to make Shop Pay Installment payments.

1.9 You can find more information on paying with installments here.

Order Tracking

1.10 Order tracking operates in different ways:

  1. if the email account you use to sign up for Shop is the same email account you used to make a purchase with a Merchant who uses the Shopify features, products or services (a “Shopify Merchant”), we will automatically populate that Order Information in Shop;
  2. if you make a purchase on a Shop Pay Site using Shop Pay and you have a Shop account, we will automatically populate that Order Information in Shop;
  3. if you have a supported email account (for example, Gmail), we will populate that Order Information in Shop via tokenized read access to your supported email account;
  4. other accounts may also be voluntarily connected, where with your permission, we may access the applicable Order Information to provide you with tracking notifications; or
  5. if you do not have a supported email account, or if you do not wish to grant Shop tokenized read access to your email or other accounts, you can manually input tracking information or forward relevant order tracking emails to a Shop-provided endpoint.

For 1.10(1)-(5) above, you acknowledge and agree that Shop will obtain relevant Shipping Information (including tracking numbers) and Order Information on your behalf and import this information into Shop for you to track and manage your purchase. Shop may also obtain a reference to the email that contains this information. In accordance with the Shop Privacy Policy, we do not permanently store any email content. Emails filtered by Shop will only be looked at by humans if you specifically allow this type of access.

Shop may also make personalized recommendations to you based on Merchants you follow or your Saved Information. Notwithstanding any features or tools that we might make available in Shop, and unless otherwise explicitly stated, we do not endorse, and we are not affiliated with any Merchant or their Products.

Post-Purchase Offers will continue to be exposed to you in various surface areas in Shop until the discount has expired or you use it.
